title: Inter: 14 things the papers printed this week — one came true | Nerazzurri Daily No. 33
description:
Fourteen Inter claims in the Italian press this week. The club has confirmed one.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=33

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it, Oct 2 — Marcus Thuram was the only forward training at Appiano Gentile. Gazzetta dello Sport called it on Sep 30.
REPORTED · TEAMtalk, Sep 27 — Chelsea want Alessandro Bastoni, about £70 million. Still open.
REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport, Oct 4 — Inter want to extend Bastoni past 2028. Still open.
REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport, Oct 2, then Sky Sport Italia, Oct 2 — Hakan Calhanoglu back with the group, then part-time only. Still open.
Tally: 1 of 14 reported items confirmed by the club. 13 still open, none denied.
